name: context-relay
description: Above a context threshold, a button summarizes the conversation (goal, shipped, up next, locked in) into relais.md and offers to continue in a new session.

threshold.title: Context threshold (%)
threshold.description: The context-relay button appears when context reaches this percentage.

openInFolder.title: Open the new session in this folder
openInFolder.description: Gives the new session the project folder, but the app then asks to trust it and the first message is slower. Off: the new session opens like any other.
